# Template provenance

The report uses only acl.sty and acl_natbib.bst from the supplied project template. Both files are byte-identical to the corresponding official ACL style files checked on 2026-11-15. No prior report prose, personal data, slides, logo or example images are included.

ACL template distribution: https://github.com/acl-org/acl-style-files and https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/association-for-computational-linguistics-acl-conference/jvxskxpnznfj (CC BY 4.0). The bibliography style preserves its original Norman Gray and Patrick Daly copyright and LPPL version 1 or later notice. Legal copyright notices identify upstream authors rather than additional authors of this report.
